requirements.text: 3–8 years of professional software engineering experience, including substantial ownership of production frontend applications
Strong proficiency with JavaScript or TypeScript and hands-on experience building complex applications with React
Build and maintain production web applications using React, TypeScript, HTML, and modern CSS
Translate Figma designs and product requirements into reusable, accessible components and complete user workflows
Design frontend architecture for state management, data fetching, routing, and integration with REST or GraphQL APIs
Improve application performance through code splitting, caching, bundle analysis, image optimization, and Core Web Vitals monitoring
Solid understanding of browser fundamentals, responsive design, accessibility standards, semantic HTML, CSS architecture, and cross-browser behavior
Experience integrating RESTful or GraphQL APIs, managing asynchronous state, and working with frontend data-fetching or state-management libraries
Demonstrated ability to write maintainable automated tests and troubleshoot performance, reliability, and production issues
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent professional experience
Bonus: experience with Next.js, React Native, design systems, Storybook, web analytics, accessibility compliance, or server-side rendering
